close_reason: Doctest .expect() message updated to make doctest-only context explicit
description: The doctest calls .expect("all known") — a contributor reading this will copy the pattern into library code where .expect() is forbidden by CLAUDE.md. The example is in a doctest so it won't be caught by clippy. A contributor who copies this pattern into a handler will introduce a panic path. The message should make it explicit this is a demonstration: e.g. .expect("this is a doctest: all URIs are in known set").
title: doc example: .expect() message too terse — pattern contributors will copy
